cutover.effectiveAuthorityRule: The target authority manifest is canonical-active with the same cutoverId. This internal pack is a pinned archive and consumer reference with no rank-one authority.

truthTypes.declarative: Approved decisions, canonical data, and canonical guidance in the pack.
truthTypes.behavioural: Tests and certified runtime fixtures built against a named pack version.
truthTypes.visual: Approved golden outputs with hashes, viewport, content fixture, decision IDs, and certification status. Figma alone is never visual truth.

certificationRequirements: reachable from a recorded path or commit
built against a named pack version or commit
all supported breakpoint and accessibility checks pass
visual evidence is hashed and dated
human approver and approval date are recorded

currentReferences.reason: Phase 1 responsive and accessibility validation passes; design-excellence review and human certification remain outstanding.
Named integration paths are absent from the current checkout.
Visual mirror is accessible but publication, variables, and component-library status are unverified.

conflictRule: The lower-ranked source never silently overrides a higher-ranked source. Stop, record the conflict, and update the owning source first.
repositoryDecision: DEC-MIGRATION-SEQUENCE-001 supersedes the earlier Phase 4 timing. Activate the prepared standalone brand-kit after the identity kernel, clean-clone and rollback gates pass, then continue foundations, product expressions, golden outputs, Figma and channels only in the standalone canonical repository.
